REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). PROBLEM
`validate_submission.py --require-manifest` on the bundles flagged by #3398/#3397 fails for four local bundles only on the `benchmark.compliance_class` rule. The original item framed this as four bundles with a possibly missing field. The cause is different and the scope is wider.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25, executed `uv run -- python scripts/validate_submission.py --require-manifest <bundles>` on an origin/develop export)
- 20 sidecars now carry `defective-superseded-sql-translation` (18 from #3398 plus 2 ClickHouse Local DataVault bundles from #3397). Exactly 4 of the 20 fail: tpcds_sf1_clickhouse_local_sql_20260826_112830_c250741b, tpcds_sf1_datafusion_sql_20260826_094401_5207d224, tpch/clickhouse-local/sf1.0/tpch_sf1_clickhouse_local_sql_20261001_142203_f22a0442 and ..._20261013_011942_678507a6 (several bundles live in bundle subdirectories, not only results-data/bundles/*.json).
- The failure is not a missing field: `benchmark.compliance_class='unofficial_nonstandard' is not accepted for public submissions; only compliance_class=official may be submitted`. The rule is `CLI_REFUSED_COMPLIANCE_CLASSES = {unofficial_nonstandard, unofficial_subscale}` in benchbox/validation/bundle.py.
- Corpus-wide: of 419 payloads, 361 have no compliance_class, 24 are `official`, 20 `unofficial_nonstandard`, 14 `unofficial_subscale`. Running the same validator on all 34 unofficial ones gives 34 FAIL (47 errors, 7 warnings, 2 overrides required), including currently ranked unflagged TPC-H DuckDB/DataFusion bundles at SF0.01, SF0.1 and SF1.0 (explorer ranks subscale as 'Subscale - Unofficial' since #3075). So the public-submission gate and the maintainer corpus disagree, and a replacement bundle produced by a subscale or non-standard run cannot pass this validator as written.
- cloud-bundle-metadata-gaps covers missing metadata on cloud bundles; it does not cover this rule.

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 Policy. Options: (a) document and implement an exemption for `result_source: internal` (maintainer) corpus bundles and replacements from the CLI-refused-class rule, keeping it for external submissions (recommended: subscale cohorts can never be `official`, so requiring official is impossible for SF0.01/0.1); (b) require `official` for every replacement and shrink or drop the subscale cohorts; (c) leave the validator as is and treat `--require-manifest` on corpus bundles as not applicable (document it). Any of these is a validator/guard change: owner approval required, not an implementation default.
G2 Whether the 4 flagged bundles are replaced by reruns (preferred; they are already unranked) or kept as flagged history.

GUARDRAILS
- Never edit bundle JSON or relabel `compliance_class` in an existing bundle (the sidecar bundle_hash binds it).
- Do not weaken the check for external submissions; add a negative test proving it.
- No publication or ingestion in this item.

STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`. Stop and ask the owner on unexpected result changes, relaxed guards, oracle stand-ins or real design choices.
